mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, increasing leflunomide metabolism and reducing active metabolite (A77 1726) concentrations, potentially decreasing therapeutic efficacy in rheumatoid arthritis treatment.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor disease activity closely; if co-administration necessary, consider leflunomide dose adjustment and therapeutic drug monitoring of A77 1726 levels.
